verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and self-contained. The necessity direction constructs an injection from each subset S into N(S) using the matching. The sufficiency direction validly applies induction on |X|: a nonempty proper tight subset permits compatible matchings on the induced pieces, while in the absence of such a subset deleting one adjacent pair preserves Hall's inequalities. The cases are exhaustive, all endpoint-disjointness claims are justified, and no prohibited or unverified references are used.
